trap.label: falso cognato / sufixo
trap.wrong: The study is conclusive: it concludes of that tea is healthy.
trap.right: The study concludes that tea is healthy.
trap.why: Em português "conclui-se de que". Em inglês, conclude é seguido de that, sem of.

mcq.q: Complete: I **___** that it is safe.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com conclude that: “Our conclusion: it is safe.”
rewrite.answer: We conclude that it is safe.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “They conclude that it is safe.”
rewrite.answer: They concluded that it is safe.
